messages:
Kay: Starting a short thread: finalizing Obsidian dark-mode tweaks. Main items: heatmap semantics, code token legibility, and the toggle copy. Low-friction decisions please.
Mina: Heatmap: current red->yellow scale reads noisy. I'd prefer a luminance-priority ramp (dark->light) with low-chroma overlays for category hints. Keeps ordering for colorblind folks.
Raj: For inline code and blocks: identifiers are bright electric blue. Move to a softer teal (lower saturation) so long paste sessions don't fatigue eyes. Reserve electric for actionable links only.
Theo: Chart series: when stacked, similar hues blend. Propose increasing lightness delta by 10% and adding a 1px semi-transparent divider on adjacent paths. Also avoid adjacent series with same perceived luminance.
Mina: Accessibility: legend and axis labels should be >=14px or 4.5:1. Current 12px/#98A3AE on #07080A fails. Suggest 14px with #C6CFD6 or keep 12px but darker #B0B9C0.
Kay: Toggle copy: ditch "Dim" — it's ambiguous. Use "Appearance: Light / Dark / System" and aria-label="Toggle appearance". Add a tooltip hint: "Press T to toggle".
Raj: Perf note: patterns/textures for heatmap look nice but balloon canvas paints. Use 1px dividers and CSS borders rather than per-cell textures.
Theo: For A/B, we can roll "Luma-first + chroma hints" vs "Muted spectrum" to 5% each and collect misread events on legends. Keep rollout gated until perf tests pass.
design-bot: Created ticket UX-9472 with Figma frames https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/obsidian-theme (internal).
Kay: I'll update tokens and Figma frames tonight, add a short test plan to UX-9472, and schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
